name: hash
description:
Converts a string into a fixed length hexadecimal string.

NOTE: The result is useful for comparison and validation, such as storing and validating a hashed password without exposing the original password.

params.name: algorithm
params.description:
CF7+ A supported algorithm such as MD5,SHA,SHA-256,SHA-384, or SHA-512. Of those listed SHA-512 is the strongest and generates a 128 character hex result.

NOTE: The default is SHA-256 in CF2025+, CF2023.0.8+ and CF2021.0.14+. Earlier versions default to CFMX_COMPAT, which produces an MD5 hash. Lucee defaults to MD5.

NOTE: The Enterprise Edition of ColdFusion installs the RSA BSafe Crypto-J library, which provides FIPS-140 Compliant Strong Cryptography. This includes additional algorithms. You can also install additional cryptography algorithms and use those hashing algorithms.

params.name: encoding
params.description:
CF7+ A string specifying the encoding to use when converting the string to byte data used by the hash algorithm.
Must be a character encoding name recognized by the Java runtime.

NOTE: The default is specified by the value of `defaultCharset` in the `neo-runtime.xml` file, which is normally `UTF-8`. 
NOTE: This is ignored when using the `CFMX_COMPAT` algorithm.

params.name: additionalIterations
params.description:
CF10+ Iterates the number of times the hash is computed to create a more computationally intensive hash. Lucee and Adobe CF implement this differently (off by one), see compatibility notes below.

NOTE: This parameter appears to be ignored if the `CFMX_COMPAT` default algorithm is used.

params.name: outputEncoding
params.description: CF2025+ The format of the returned hash: `hex` (uppercase hexadecimal), `base64` or `base64url` (base64 with URL-safe characters and no padding). Pass it as a named argument.

coldfusion.notes: CF7 added additional algorithm support, CF10 added the iterations option. CF2018 uses `additionalIterations` as the iterations param. The default algorithm changed from CFMX_COMPAT (MD5) to SHA-256 in CF2023.0.8+ and CF2021.0.14+. CF2025+ removed the CFMX_COMPAT algorithm and added `outputEncoding`, which must be passed as a named argument (the fourth positional argument is still `additionalIterations`). In 2025.0.14, passing `outputEncoding` without `additionalIterations` hashes one extra time, so also pass `additionalIterations=0`; omitting `algorithm` with `outputEncoding` throws an error.

lucee.notes: The iterations value represents the total number of hashes on Lucee, in Adobe CF the value is the number of additional iterations. In Lucee5+, the iterations param is `numIterations`.

examples.title: MD5 Hash Example
examples.description: MD5 is not recommended for use requiring security. Without an algorithm, this returns an MD5 hash only on engines where MD5 is the default (Lucee, and ColdFusion before 2023.0.8 or 2021.0.14). Newer ColdFusion versions return a SHA-256 hash.
